mode_reason: ISOLATED (operator 2026-08-20): supersedes the RC-129 shared-root decision. Claude must never edit application source in the production checkout again; the primary is production-only, clean current main. RC-125 (probe-live) and RC-350 (one-app clean main) are BOTH kept: Claude's edit->restart->probe loop runs against the tree the CLAUDE PROOF server serves — the -Claude worktree — on a NON-PRODUCTION port with a NON-PRODUCTION proof DB, so the running server serves Claude's own edits (RC-125) while production keeps running clean main on 8000 (RC-350). git's one-branch-per-worktree rule is satisfied because Claude's feature branch is checked out only in the -Claude worktree. Flip back to shared-root only by operator decision.
description: Isolated operation. Cursor/operator use the primary production checkout (must NOT end with -Claude); Claude uses <primary>-Claude via a linked git worktree (shared .git object store), on its own feature branch. In isolated mode the role<->path binding and linked-worktree check are ENFORCED (worktree_boundary_violations), and the edit-time boundary guard BLOCKS a claude-role mutation whose target is inside the primary checkout. No absolute operator-home paths — suffix + ED_AGENT_ROLE only.

claude_proof_runtime.db: non-production proof DB via ED_CONSOLE_DB=<worktree>/data/ed_console_proof.db + ED_CONSOLE_ALLOW_NONCANONICAL_DB=1; the canonical production DB data/ed_console.db is singular and MUST NOT be written by the proof runtime
claude_proof_runtime.reason: RC-125 rendered-DOM/probe-live verification runs against the Claude worktree's own server without touching production port 8000 or the canonical DB

roles.cursor: Primary worktree; must NOT end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=cursor required.
roles.claude: Dedicated worktree; directory name MUST end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=claude required.

fail_fast: ED_AGENT_ROLE unset or invalid → exit 1. No inference from directory name.
db: PRODUCTION canonical DB is singular: data/ed_console.db, written ONLY by the production runtime in the primary checkout. RC-401 removed the AMBIENT per-agent fork (ED_AGENT_ROLE silently choosing data/ed_console_claude.db scattered rows across three files) — ambient forking stays banned. The Claude PROOF runtime instead uses an EXPLICIT, opt-in non-production DB via ED_CONSOLE_DB=<worktree>/data/ed_console_proof.db + ED_CONSOLE_ALLOW_NONCANONICAL_DB=1, so proof/dev writes never reach the canonical production DB. ED_CONSOLE_DB / ED_DB_PATH override; a non-canonical target still requires ED_CONSOLE_ALLOW_NONCANONICAL_DB=1.
handoff: Commit or stash in the active worktree before the other agent reads shared HEAD. tools/check_worktree_handoff.py enforces dirty-source + boundary.
